IN THE COURT OF MR. ALI JAWAD NAQVI , CIVIL JUDGE 1 ST CLASS, RAWALPINDI 
 
 
 
 Civil Suit No. _____ /202 4 
 
 
 
 Shaikh Muhammad Wahab 
 versus 
 Mall 35 etc. 
 
 (SUIT FOR DECLARATION, RECOVERY O F POSSESSION , PERMANENT AND MANDATORY INJUNCTION). 
 
 APPLICATION 
 Under Order I, Rule 10 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for deletion/striking out of the Applicant/Defendant No. 0 1 / Zameen.com name from the array of the Defendant s of the titled Application. 
 Respectfully Sheweth : 
 That the titled case is pending adjudication before this learned Court and is fixed for hearing today on 28 -0 4 -202 5 . 
 
 That this Application is being filed without prejudice to the rights of the Applicant/ Defendant No. 02 to challenge and raise objections as to the maintainability of the above-titled Suit at a later stage . 
 
 That at the outset is submitted that the Plaintiff in the titled Suit has impleaded Zameen.com as a Defendant No. 0 2 through its CEO Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan . It is necessary to clarify here that Zameen.com is not a legal entity or a person and is just a brand name, owned and controlled by the Applicant Company under the name and style of Zameen Media Private Limited, a private limited company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2017 (hereinafter referred to as the Applicant/ Defendant Company ) and , therefore , t he Applicant/Defendant Company is filing the instant Application through Syed Hassan Ali Shah, Associate Director (Admin &amp; Project Controls), who is fully conversant with the facts of the case and has been duly authorized to file, sign and verify the pleadings in order to defend against titled Suit . 
 That as per the plaint filed in the titled suit, the alleged dispute emanates from an Agreement dated 22 - 12 - 2019 ( t he “ Agreement ” ) which has seemingly prompted the Plaintiff to file the titled Suit . 
 
 That i t is most pertinent to note that the Applicant/Defendant Company is not a party to the Agreement . 
 
 That the Applicant/Defendant Company is not a necessary or proper party in the titled Suit . Neither the Applicant/Defendant Company has any in terest in the titled Suit nor has any connection with the relief c laimed in the titled Suit . This learned Court is vested with the jurisdiction of striking off the name of the Applicant in as much as it is not a proper or necessary party to the titled Suit and has no interest in the titled Suit and no connection with the relief claimed in the titled Suit . 
 
 That t he Applicant/ Defendant Company as a distinct entity has NO NEXUS WITH THE AGREEMENT or the transaction in question or the s ubject matter of the titled Suit and has been impleaded unnecessarily by the Plaintiff / Respondent , therefore , t he Applicant/ Defendant Company merits to be struck off from the array of Defendants in the titled Suit . 
 
 That the Applicant/ Defendant Company is a stranger to the aforesaid Agreement hence the Applicant/ Defendant Company is neither a proper nor a necessary party to the proceedings since the Applicant/ Defendant Company is not even remotely connected with the issue . Thus , it is only just, fair, proper and equitable for t he Applicant/ Defendant Company ( Defendant No . 02 ) to be deleted from the array of Defendant s. 
 
 The Court has to minutely examine the pecuniary facts of each case and after satisfying itself, as to whether the case for deleting/striking out of the name has been made out in the matter, pass necessary orders by allowing such request. The Court has to see and examine the averments made in the application primarily to decide this aspect of the case, as there is no standard rule or procedure laid down, except to examine the contents of the application and the facts and circumstances of the case. 
 
 The object of adding a proper party to a case/suit i s to avoid needless multiplicit y in that particular case . A pe rson impleaded in a case must be such a person whose interest was likely to be affected even if no relief was claimed against him and did not extend to a person who had no interest that was likely to be affected by the proceedings nor does it embrace a person whose general interest was in common with others. Name of such a d efendant which is found to be neither a necessary nor a proper party can be struck out and where there is no cause of action against such defendant. Where a person who has been impleaded as a formal Defendant in the suit/case is neither a necessary party nor proper party nor any relief ha s been sought by the applicant against it , its name as a d efendant must be struck off from the case/suit . Moreover, the Court s also have suo motu powers to strike off name s of d efendant who may have been wrongly and unnecessarily impleaded and against whom no cause of action is shown by the Plaintiff . The o nly reason which makes it necessary to make a person a party to an action is that it should be bound by the result of the action /the court’s order. In the instant case, as mentioned above, the Applicant/Defendant No. 1 has no nexus with the Agreement dated 22 - 12-2019 which allegedly forms the basis of the Plaintiff’s cause of action. 
 
 PRAYER 
 Wherefore, it is most humbly prayed that this learned Court may most graciously be pleased to accept the instant Application and delete/strike off the name of Defendant No. 02 Zameen Media from the array of Defendant s to the titled suit . 
 
 Any other better relief deemed fit and appropriate may also most graciously be granted in favour of The Applicant/ Defendant Company. 
 
 
 Applicant/Defendant Company 
 Zameen Media ( Pvt. ) Ltd 
 
 Through
